findings.finding: AgentBridgeService writes canonical data only through IngestService and delegates extraction/consolidation to the existing Phase 2A services; it does not write SQLite directly.

Start, capture, and finish use deterministic event identities. Replays return duplicates, while changed content under an existing identity raises ConflictError; capture sequence and parent links are reconstructed from the first stored capture event.

The manual Skill excludes hidden reasoning, credentials, host instructions, and unrelated plugin text. Manual evidence defaults to summary completeness and is marked as a known limitation rather than pretending to be a full transcript.

The request model still permits an adapter to explicitly claim full completeness or submit arbitrary visible paths; Phase 5B should add stricter adapter-level completeness/path policy if automatic transports need stronger enforcement.
The bridge is provider-neutral and usable through localhost HTTP or CLI without Codex Desktop private APIs; the sanitized Project_J fixture exercises the same lifecycle contract.

unverified_assumptions: Codex Desktop Skill invocation and local service startup remain user-environment concerns; no private desktop hook is assumed.
The checked-in Project_J fixture is sanitized evidence and is not a live source-tree verification run.
